about.title:
We build calm software
for ambitious teams.
about.subtitle: Swantara started with a simple observation: most teams do not need more tools. They need fewer places to look.
about.storyP1: We spent years building operations for growing companies and watching the same pattern repeat. A promising business would outgrow its spreadsheets, add a tool for every team, and slowly lose the thread that connected it all.
about.storyP2: Swantara began as a shared record — one place where orders, stock, invoices and people could agree. That small idea grew into a complete operating system, designed to feel quiet even when the business is loud.
about.storyP3: Today, teams in 18 countries use Swantara to close their books, ship their products and take care of their people. We are still a small team, and we still believe software should make work feel lighter.
about.value1Description: The best interface is the one your team understands on the first try. We choose plain language and obvious next steps.
about.value2Description: Small things compound. A well-designed approval, a clear empty state and a fast page all add up to trust.
about.value3Description: We ship in small, useful increments and listen closely to the people doing the work.
about.value4Description: Your operating data is serious business. We treat security, privacy and reliability as product features.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How Swantara collects, uses, and protects personal data in your workspace. Written to be read, not skipped.
privacy.section1P1: Swantara is the software platform described in this policy. Where Swantara processes personal data on behalf of a customer workspace, that customer is the controller and Swantara is the processor.
privacy.section1P2: This policy covers the Swantara web app, API, and communications. Customer workspaces maintain their own policies toward their employees and their customers.
privacy.section2P1: Account data you provide: name, email, company, and workspace configuration. Operational data your team creates: contacts, orders, stock movements, journal entries, timesheets, and messages.
privacy.section2P2: Usage data we measure: log entries, device information, and product analytics that help us find rough edges. We do not sell data, and we do not run advertising.
privacy.section3P1: To operate the service: store your data, apply your rules, deliver documents, and keep the platform reliable and secure.
privacy.section3P2: To improve the product: aggregate analysis of feature usage. Personal data is never used to train third-party AI models without explicit consent.
privacy.section4P1: We process personal data to perform our contract with you, for legitimate interests in securing and improving the service, and where required by law — such as financial record-keeping obligations.
privacy.section4P2: Where consent is the appropriate basis, you can withdraw it at any time without affecting processing that already happened.
privacy.section5P1: Selected subprocessors help us run the platform: hosting and CDN, transactional email, payment processing, and error monitoring. Each is bound by confidentiality and security obligations.
privacy.section5P2: We disclose data only to the extent these services require, on a customer's instruction, or to comply with a valid legal order.
privacy.section6P1: We keep workspace data for as long as the workspace is active. When a subscription ends, data remains exportable for 30 days, then is deleted from production systems within 90 days.
privacy.section6P2: Backups age out on a rolling schedule. Financial records are retained only as long as applicable law requires.
privacy.section7P1: You can access, correct, export, and delete personal data at any time, directly from within the product. Requests from your end customers are handled on behalf of the workspace owner.
privacy.section7P2: Questions or complaints about privacy can go to privacy@swantara.com. You also have the right to raise a complaint with your local data protection authority.
privacy.relatedNote: Questions about this document? Write to

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The agreement between you and Swantara when using the platform. Plain language, kept promises.
terms.section1P1: By creating an account or using a Swantara workspace, you agree to these terms on behalf of yourself and the organization you represent.
terms.section1P2: If you are accepting on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you have the authority to bind it.
terms.section2P1: You are responsible for the accuracy of account data and for every action taken under your credentials. Report suspected misuse promptly to security@swantara.com.
terms.section2P2: We may require two-factor authentication and may suspend accounts that pose a security risk to the platform.
terms.section3P1: Paid plans are billed in advance, monthly or annually, in the currency set at checkout. Fees are non-refundable except where required by law or as stated in the trial policy.
terms.section3P2: We may adjust prices with at least 30 days' notice. Renewal continues automatically on the same cycle until you cancel.
terms.section4P1: Trials are free and do not require a card. If a trial ends without a chosen plan, the workspace converts to Starter with its limits and stays fully exportable.
terms.section4P2: Free and trial workspaces may be reclaimed after prolonged inactivity, with advance notice before deletion.
terms.section5P1: You agree not to misuse the service: no unlawful content, no attempts to break or overload the platform, and no reselling of access contrary to our policy.
terms.section5P2: We may limit or terminate use that clearly threatens other customers, the platform, or applicable law.
terms.section6P1: Swantara and its software, design, and documentation remain our property. You receive a non-exclusive license to use the service during your subscription.
terms.section6P2: Your data, documents, and configurations belong to you. We take no ownership of what you create in your workspace.
terms.section7P1: We target 99.9% monthly uptime and publish live status. Planned maintenance is announced in advance and scheduled to minimize disruption.
terms.section7P2: Support response commitments vary by plan, as described on the support page.
terms.section8P1: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Swantara's aggregate liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim.
terms.section8P2: Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages. Nothing in these terms limits liability for fraud or willful misconduct.
terms.section9P1: You can stop the service at any time; data stays exportable for 30 days. We may terminate with notice as required for the plan.
terms.section9P2: Material changes to these terms are announced at least 15 days in advance by email and in-product notice.
terms.relatedNote: Questions about this document? Write to

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement
dpa.intro: The standard DPA that applies to every Swantara workspace: roles, safeguards, subprocessors, and rights — in one readable document.
dpa.section1P1: Each customer is the controller of the personal data entered into their workspace; Swantara is the processor handling that data to deliver the service described in the terms of service.
dpa.section1P2: This agreement covers processing for the duration of the subscription, plus any backup retention period that follows.
dpa.section2P1: Processing supports business operations: contact management, orders, inventory, accounting, HR and payroll, and service workflows.
dpa.section2P2: Data categories include customer and supplier contact details, employee names and payroll references, and document content. No special-category data is required to use the platform.
dpa.section3P1: Processing lasts as long as the subscription. For 30 days after termination, data is export-only, then deleted from production systems and aged out of backups on schedule.
dpa.section3P2: We return or delete all personal data after the export window, except where applicable law mandates retention.
dpa.section4P1: Swantara applies encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access, immutable audit logging, daily encrypted backups, and quarterly penetration testing.
dpa.section4P2: The full control catalog is described on the security page, and we provide a completed security questionnaire on request.
dpa.section5P1: Customers authorize the use of the subprocessors listed in the annex to this agreement: hosting and CDN, email delivery, payment processing, and error monitoring.
dpa.section5P2: We notify customers of new subprocessors at least 14 days before use, and every subprocessor signs confidentiality and equivalent data-protection obligations.
dpa.section6P1: Requests routed to Swantara are forwarded to the relevant workspace owner without undue delay, and we assist with access, correction, export, and deletion.
dpa.section6P2: Swantara does not respond to end-customer requests directly unless authorized by the controller.
dpa.section7P1: Workspace data is hosted in the region selected at setup — Jakarta by default.
dpa.section7P2: For occasional cross-border processing, we rely on standard contractual clauses and supplementary safeguards.
dpa.relatedNote: Questions about this agreement? Write to
